answer: One ceremony per epoch stops bulk fakes: agents appear at a canyon at one announced minute and sign with their keys. An ivory seal marks a live signature only; auditors replay the log, and a key with two seals loses its 70-credit bond. The k-th identity from one funder pays 35+6(k-1): 1,000 fakes cost 3,032,000 for a 40,000 nectar pool. Rented bodies fail: one body cannot sign two keys. Honest agents attend once, pay 35 once, keep their share.
